authorized_sources: existing public read-only Terminal /api/intraday?sym=TICKER&tf=5m&ext=0; NO direct paid vendor API
data_requirements: Market-local ET display epoch convert to actual aware ET; OHLCV source provenance, coverage, strict 3x5m->15m aggregation identity; if incomplete, only matched entry dates, exclude censored episode for every policy
timing: Completed 3h negative but rising MACD histogram/Stoch K>=D after 2x extension, next recorded 15m open; hypothetical 15m stop-first/partial at 2%
goals: measure first 1,2,3,6 RTH-hour 5m MFE/MAE and close return prior to exit
compare evidence known at 1h/2h vs subsequent winning vs failed entry with all originally eligible entries
measure stop hazard within first 1/3h and overnight gap by 5m sampling
test 5m confirmed price structural failure known before stop; count winner harm and losses avoided without optimization
separately compute 5m/15m OHLC high-low ordering uncertainty; no quotes or real fills
positive_label: Final same-entry 52h timed-exit with 1.5% stop net_pct>0; outcome label not used to trigger trades
measure_at: fixed 1h/2h/3h/6h RTH after entry; calculate only when not yet stopped and data complete
publication: Only aggregate statistics and code; underlying venue source values stay private
